page.overview:
Who is Meowy?

Meowy is a cat with black ears, a black spot on the top of its head, and a black tip on its tail (both brown in the anime). It has yellow-green eyes.

Meowy was brought under the care of Power, who originally intended to fatten up Meowy before eating it. Power eventually becomes attached to Meowy and they were together for a long time until Meowy was captured by the Bat Devil, who promised that if a human were brought to him he would return Meowy.

When Power returned with Denji, Meowy was eaten by the Bat Devil as punishment for bringing him blood that tasted disgusting. Meowy was freed along with Power after the defeat of the Bat Devil.

It seemed that Meowy frequently slept with Denji rather than Power which slightly annoyed her.
